program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((g180 (rotate-180 g))
                (glr (flip-lr g))
                (gud (flip-ud g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (if (!= v 4)
                        v
                        (let* ((v180 (at g180 r c))
                               (vh (at glr r c))
                               (vv (at gud r c)))
                          (cond
                            ((!= v180 4) v180)
                            ((!= vh 4) vh)
                            ((!= vv 4) vv)
                            (else 4))))))))
